routes.documentation: Save a payee to Quick pay. Body: { key, method, name, bank, display, nickname }

responses.label: 409 Already saved
422 Missing details

responses.body:
{{setVar 'nick' (bodyRaw 'nickname')}}{{#unless @nick}}{{setVar 'nick' (bodyRaw 'name')}}{{/unless}}{{setData 'push' 'favourites' '' (object key=(bodyRaw 'key') method=(bodyRaw 'method') name=(bodyRaw 'name') bank=(bodyRaw 'bank') display=(bodyRaw 'display') nickname=@nick removed=false)}}{
  "key": "{{body 'key'}}",
  "method": "{{body 'method'}}",
  "name": "{{body 'name'}}",
  "bank": "{{body 'bank'}}",
  "display": "{{body 'display'}}",

}
responses.label: 201 Saved
401 Session expired

routes.documentation: Remove a payee from Quick pay

responses.body: {{#each (dataRaw 'favourites')}}{{#if (eq key (urlParam 'key'))}}{{setData 'set' 'favourites' (concat @index '.removed') true}}{{/if}}{{/each}}
responses.label: 204 Removed
404 Not in Quick pay
401 Session expired

routes.documentation: Find who an account number or PayID belongs to. Body: { method, value }

responses.body: {{{stringify (find (dataRaw 'payees') (object key=(lowercase (body 'value')) method=(body 'method')))}}}
responses.label: 200 Payee found
404 No payee
401 Session expired

routes.documentation: Pay someone. Body: { fromAccountId, method, payee, payeeName, payeeBank, payeeDisplay, amount, reference }

responses.label: 422 Invalid amount
422 Not enough money

responses.body:
{{setVar 'amt' (bodyRaw 'amount' 0)}}{{setVar 'pid' (concat 'pay_' (faker 'string.numeric' 6))}}{{setVar 'today' (now 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}{{setVar 'cat' (body 'reference')}}{{#unless @cat}}{{setVar 'cat' 'Payment'}}{{/unless}}{{#if (eq (body 'fromAccountId') 'acc_sav')}}{{setVar 'idx' '1'}}{{else}}{{setVar 'idx' '0'}}{{/if}}{{setData 'dec' 'accounts' (concat @idx '.balance') @amt}}{{setData 'set' 'accounts' '0.balance' (divide (round (multiply (dataRaw 'accounts' '0.balance') 100)) 100)}}{{setData 'set' 'accounts' '1.balance' (divide (round (multiply (dataRaw 'accounts' '1.balance') 100)) 100)}}{{setData 'push' 'transactions' '' (object id=@pid title=(bodyRaw 'payeeName') category=@cat date=@today amount=(subtract 0 @amt) icon='transfer')}}{{#unless (find (dataRaw 'recents') (object key=(body 'payee')))}}{{setData 'push' 'recents' '' (object key=(bodyRaw 'payee') method=(bodyRaw 'method') name=(bodyRaw 'payeeName') bank=(bodyRaw 'payeeBank') display=(bodyRaw 'payeeDisplay') lastPaid=@today)}}{{/unless}}{
  "id": "{{@pid}}",
  "status": "completed",
  "fromAccountId": "{{body 'fromAccountId'}}",
  "payeeName": "{{body 'payeeName'}}",
  "amount": {{@amt}},
  "reference": "{{body 'reference' ''}}",
  "date": "{{@today}}"
}
responses.label: 201 Payment sent
401 Session expired

routes.documentation: Create an account. Body: { fullName, email, phone, password }. Login details go to the credentials bucket.

responses.label: 422 Missing details
409 Email already registered

responses.body:
{{setVar 'uid' (concat 'usr_' (faker 'string.numeric' 4))}}{{setVar 'created' (now 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}{{setVar 'fn' (substr (bodyRaw 'fullName') 0 (indexOf (bodyRaw 'fullName') ' '))}}{{setData 'push' 'signups' '' (object id=@uid firstName=@fn fullName=(bodyRaw 'fullName') email=(lowercase (body 'email')) phone=(bodyRaw 'phone') createdAt=@created)}}{{setData 'push' 'credentials' '' (object userId=@uid email=(lowercase (body 'email')) password=(bodyRaw 'password'))}}{
  "id": "{{@uid}}",
  "fullName": "{{body 'fullName'}}",
  "email": "{{lowercase (body 'email')}}",
  "createdAt": "{{@created}}",
  "message": "Account created. You can now sign in."
}

responses.body:
{{setVar 'amt' (bodyRaw 'amount' 0)}}{{setVar 'tid' (concat 'trf_' (faker 'string.numeric' 6))}}{{setVar 'today' (now 'yyyy-MM-dd')}}{{setVar 'cat' (body 'note')}}{{#unless @cat}}{{setVar 'cat' 'Own transfer'}}{{/unless}}{{#if (eq (body 'fromAccountId') 'acc_chk')}}{{setData 'dec' 'accounts' '0.balance' @amt}}{{setData 'inc' 'accounts' '1.balance' @amt}}{{setData 'push' 'transactions' '' (object id=@tid title='To Savings' category=@cat date=@today amount=(subtract 0 @amt) icon='own-transfer')}}{{else}}{{setData 'inc' 'accounts' '0.balance' @amt}}{{setData 'dec' 'accounts' '1.balance' @amt}}{{setData 'push' 'transactions' '' (object id=@tid title='From Savings' category=@cat date=@today amount=@amt icon='own-transfer')}}{{/if}}{{setData 'set' 'accounts' '0.balance' (divide (round (multiply (dataRaw 'accounts' '0.balance') 100)) 100)}}{{setData 'set' 'accounts' '1.balance' (divide (round (multiply (dataRaw 'accounts' '1.balance') 100)) 100)}}{
  "id": "{{@tid}}",
  "status": "completed",
  "fromAccountId": "{{body 'fromAccountId'}}",
  "toAccountId": "{{body 'toAccountId'}}",
  "amount": {{@amt}},
  "note": "{{body 'note' ''}}",

}
